title: Hypercalcemia: Corrected Calcium, Symptoms and ECG
subject: Electrolytes
preview: Hypercalcemia can cause constipation, polyuria, dehydration, weakness, confusion and shortened QT interval.
quickRevision: Hypercalcemia can cause constipation, polyuria, dehydration, weakness, confusion and shortened QT interval.
Common causes include primary hyperparathyroidism and malignancy; PTH helps guide etiologic classification.
Symptomatic severe hypercalcemia requires careful fluid and renal assessment, ECG monitoring and cause-specific treatment.

sections.title: Interpret the result in context
points: Hypercalcemia can cause constipation, polyuria, dehydration, weakness, confusion and shortened QT interval.
Albumin influences total serum calcium; ionized calcium helps clarify ambiguous results, especially when albumin or pH is abnormal.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not rely on a corrected-calcium formula in every critically ill patient without considering ionized measurement.
